mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and inhibit CYP2C9/CYP3A4, increasing risk of liver injury and leflunomide accumulation through impaired metabolism of its active metabolite A77 1726.
action: Monitor liver function tests closely (AST, ALT, bilirubin) at baseline and regularly during concurrent use; consider alternative TB therapy if possible or dose adjustment of leflunomide.
